title: Amalfi Coast: Sail & Supper
summary: A week paced around the water and the table — a private boat between towns, a pasta-making morning, and dinners that don't need a reservation six months out.
highlights: Private boat from Positano to Nerano
Pasta-making in a Ravello family kitchen
The Path of the Gods hike, timed early
A family vineyard wine tasting above the water

itinerary.title: Arrive on the coast
itinerary.description: A private transfer along the coast road into a quiet town most itineraries skip.

itinerary.title: Boat day
itinerary.description: Your own boat and driver, Positano to Nerano, swim stops chosen as you go.

itinerary.title: Ravello
itinerary.description: A morning pasta-making class, then Villa Cimbrone's gardens and a cliffside lunch.

itinerary.title: Path of the Gods
itinerary.description: The coast's best trail, started early to beat both heat and crowds.

itinerary.title: Open day
itinerary.description: A quiet beach club, a book, nowhere to be.

itinerary.title: Capri
itinerary.description: A full day by private boat, timed around the Blue Grotto's tide.

itinerary.title: Depart the coast
itinerary.description: One last coffee with a sea view before your transfer to Naples.

included: Private transfers and two full boat days
All guided experiences listed in the itinerary
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
excluded: Gratuities for boat crew and guides
